rows.current_interpretation: Heat-shock family with a separately measured HTH-01-015 control connection. Neighborhood, cluster and BB-effect evidence share the ridge-model basis; these are not three independent biological validation lines. No library NUAK1/ROCK target assignment is established.

The 53-member BB_8930974984 series on BB_2371372935 has the negative-neighbor cliff and strong deep-tier skew. The 47-member BB_7908408907 series has positive neighbor correlation, lower cliff percentile and no deep-tier members. Do not transfer the first series metrics to both.
The recorded z values describe a signed-rank comparison. They are not interchangeable with cosine/consensus or ensemble scores and do not establish METTL3 inhibition by library compounds.
